remarks: Fully serviced, ready-to-build 50' x 124' lot (576 m²) in Beacon Heights — level, rectangular, with rear alley access on a quiet, tree-lined street. Services are at the property line and there is no structure to remove: no demolition bill, no abatement, no as-is-where-is surprises.   A Phase 1 Environmental Site Assessment is complete and included with the sale. RS Small Scale Residential zoning supports detached, semi-detached, duplex and row-style infill. Level and rectangular with rear alley access for a garage or garage suite, on a quiet tree-lined street.   Established Edmonton infill pocket, minutes to Concordia University, Yellowhead Trail, schools, transit and shopping, where new duplex and multi-unit product is actively selling.  Most land trading in this pocket arrives with a house to tear down, this one is ready to go! (id:67522)
